name: Aige

attributes.attribute: an Irish heroine turned into a wild doe
brother of Aige and a satirist

sources: Gwynn, Edward. The Metrical Dindshenchas. Part II. Vol. IX. Royal Irish Academy, Todd Lecture Series. Dublin: Hodges, Figgis, and Co., Ltd., 1906–1924, 67.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aige was an Irish heroine. A malicious fairy, urged on by neighbors who envied her grace and charm, turned her into a wild doe. In that form she wandered the island, fleeing from hunters. The warrior Meilge killed her while he was hunting. Her brother Faifne, a satirist, tried to avenge her death and lost his own life.

okr.objective: Record Aige, an Irish heroine changed into a wild doe.
key_results: Show the fairy's spell, her death at the hands of Meilge, and her brother's revenge.
